reasons: § 12.4 is a one-sided, 24-month no-hire ('shall not solicit, hire, or employ any Vendor employee') covering all Vendor employees with no general-advertising or unsolicited-approach carve-out ('regardless of how the employee applies') — a clear deviation from the preferred position (no non-solicit on Customer) and at the walk-away line (no-hire, all personnel, 24 months).

Full deletion of p0045 is the correct and proportionate remedy: the entire paragraph is the offending no-hire, redline guidance expressly directs deleting any no-hire, and the clause directly contradicts § 12.3's acknowledgement that Customer has made no no-hire commitment.

The failed deterministic checks ('duration ≤ 12 months', 'carve-out present') are artefacts of the clause being deleted rather than narrowed; they do not indicate a defective edit since the preferred position is no restriction at all.

Comment is accurate, correctly cites the playbook position, notes the § 12.3 conflict, and offers the fallback (mutual 12-month non-solicit limited to personnel involved in the Services, with advertising/unsolicited carve-outs, no no-hire) in the required concise first-person-plural tone with the [Playbook] prefix.
